subject: On-site demo stage: vendor deposit & PO request
messages:
From: Alice Park <alice@stagemasters.co>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-06T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: On-site demo stage: vendor deposit & PO request

Hi Sofia / Jonas,

Thanks again for inviting StageMasters to support the on-site demo on June 12. Attached is a proforma invoice and our stage rider. We need a 30% deposit to secure crew and equipment — that comes to $5,550 — with the balance due within 14 days of event completion.

Can you confirm:
- Will Redwood issue a PO for the full amount ($18,500) or just the deposit?
- Which cost center should we bill to?
- If you need a W-9 for accounting, we can attach it.

Attachments: proforma_invoice_Stagemasters_050626.pdf (PDF, 120KB), stage_rider_v3.pdf (PDF, 450KB)

Cheers,
Alice Park
Vendor Relations
StageMasters Productions
billing@stagemasters.co

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-07T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: On-site demo stage: vendor deposit & PO request

Marissa — forwarding vendor invoice and rider. Jonas and I recommend issuing a PO for the full amount ($18,500) and allowing the vendor to invoice the 30% deposit up front. Reasoning: it simplifies procurement, guarantees the vendor is booked, and keeps a single PO/GL mapping for reconciliation.

High-level cost split:
- Staging & tech labor: $12,000
- Lighting & rigging: $4,500
- Travel & incidentals: $2,000
Total: $18,500

Ask from finance:
1) Approve PO up to $18,500 and confirm cost center/GL coding.
2) Confirm if we need a W-9 + vendor onboarding before PO issuance.
3) If PO approved, can Procurement create PO #PO-XXXXX and we will send vendor the DocuSign?

Attachments: proforma_invoice_Stagemasters_050626.pdf, stage_rider_v3.pdf, po_template_redwood.xlsx

Thanks — Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Regional Events Manager | Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-07T15:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: On-site demo stage: vendor deposit & PO request

Sofia — thanks for the breakdown. A few quick items before I can greenlight procurement to create the PO: 

- Please confirm the GL/cost center. I need the exact string (e.g., 4302-ENG-MKT).
- Confirm vendor tax form: if StageMasters is US-based, we need a completed W-9 on file prior to final payment. Billing email alone is not sufficient.
- Is the 30% deposit refundable? If not refundable, we need internal approval for prepay. If refundable, standard PO with deposit line is fine.

If you can provide the GL and vendor W-9 by tomorrow EOD, I’ll open the PO request and request that Procurement issue PO-98743 (tentative). Also note: our policy requires a spend cap comment on the PO for event spend > $10k. Please provide a one-liner justification to embed on the PO.

Marissa Cole
Senior Finance Business Partner | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Alice Park <alice@stagemasters.co>
Date: 2026-05-08T15:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: On-site demo stage: vendor deposit & PO request

Marissa — thanks. Confirming the details below so Procurement can proceed: 

1) Cost center / GL string: 4302-ENG-MKT (Event Programming)
2) Vendor W-9: attached in this thread from Alice (StageMasters) — cc'd here.
3) Deposit status: Non-refundable deposit required to secure crew; vendor confirmed in writing.
4) Spend cap and justification (one-liner for PO): "PO covers on-site staging, lighting, and labor for June 12 demo to ensure production-quality customer experience; not to exceed $18,500."

Please create PO-98743 for $18,500 with a deposit line for $5,550 (30%). Procurement: mark PO as "event: staging" and add cost center 4302-ENG-MKT. Once PO is issued I will send vendor the DocuSign and confirm bank details for wire.

Alice — can you confirm the payment instructions once you receive PO-98743? Also please attach a signed copy of your cancellation/refund policy (we need it for the finance file).

Thanks all —
Sofia
Regional Events Manager | Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
